items.title: Unexploded aerial bomb neutralized in Kharkiv region after hitting agricultural enterprise
items.teaser: Bomb disposal experts destroyed a 500-kilogram Russian guided aerial bomb that struck a building belonging to an agricultural enterprise in Katerynivka, Kharkiv region, but failed to detonate.

items.title: Trump says Ukraine, Russia agree to energy strike ceasefire 'because I said they agreed'
items.teaser: The U.S. president's comments came after he unilaterally announced an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine on Oct. 11, causing confusion in Kyiv. According to a senior Ukrainian official, Ukraine had no prior information about an energy ceasefire.

items.title: Merz opposes Trump's diesel deal with Putin and assures Zelensky of Germany's support
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has opposed the agreement between US President Donald Trump and Russian leader Vladimir Putin on Russian diesel fuel supplies, saying that Europe should instead increase pressure on Russia.

items.title: French Navy intercepts Russian shadow fleet tanker in Indian Ocean
items.teaser: The tanker DF Peak, previously named Kaliningrad, has falsely sailed under the flag of Benin and is sanctioned by the U.S, EU, Switzerland, Canada, and Japan.

items.title: Energy truce must be respected by both sides, says Kallas
items.teaser: The EU Foreign Affairs Council welcomes the idea of an energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia, but only on the condition that both sides respect it. Meanwhile, efforts to increase pressure on the aggressor state are continuing.

items.title: Another 11 children return to Ukrainian-controlled territory
items.teaser: Another 11 children have been returned to Ukrainian-controlled territory from temporarily occupied areas of the Kherson region.

items.title: Trump's ex-envoy Kellogg says Ukraine has every right to strike Russia
items.teaser: Speaking to Bloomberg, Keith Kellogg has defended Ukraine's long-range strikes on Russian infrastructure, arguing against allowing Moscow any sanctuaries.

items.title: “Run for Heroes” charity run in Chicago raises $10,000 for wounded Ukrainian soldiers
items.teaser: A charity run called “Run for Heroes” took place in Chicago, raising $10,000 to aid seriously wounded Ukrainian soldiers.

items.title: UK sanctions Dutch businessman exposed by Kyiv Independent for shipping EU machinery to Russian missile suppliers
items.teaser: The U.K. has sanctioned Alexander Tattersall, a Dutch national, and Redwing Metal, the Turkish company he co-owns, nearly four months after a Kyiv Independent investigation revealed the firm had funneled EU-made industrial machinery to Russian metallurgical plants that supply the country's missile and fighter jet manuf

items.title: Trump: Putin wants to reach deal more than Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Speaking to reporters at Joint Base Andrews, US President Donald Trump said Washington would push both leaders towards an agreement and argued that Ukraine's president should also want a deal.

items.title: Russian mines injure 1,739 civilians, including 178 children, since start of full-scale war
items.teaser: Since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, 1,739 people, including 178 children, have been injured by enemy mines and explosive remnants of war.

items.title: Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv before sirens, gap that lands hard amid fears that Washington could cut data that warns of launches
items.teaser: The alert came late because Ukrainian radar detected the missiles only during the attack, with no advance data on launches, the Air Force says.

items.title: Russian missile attack on Kharkiv injures at least 11, including rescuer
items.teaser: A State Emergency Service rescuer was also injured while responding to the attack and was hospitalized, RBC-Ukraine reported, citing the emergency service. His condition was not immediately confirmed.

items.title: Polen: Zwei Festnahmen in Deutschland nach Brand an Starlink-Station
items.teaser: Nach dem Brand an einer Starlink-Station in Polen gibt es Festnahmen in Deutschland. Polens Regierung vermutet Russland hinter der Sabotageaktion.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1692: Trump suspends Russian diesel sanctions, while EU blacklists record 1,569 arms suppliers
items.teaser: Washington has suspended its new sanctions on Russian diesel, and bipartisan US senators say the deal conflicts with a 2022 ban and could help finance the war.

items.title: Macron says France intercepted sanctioned Russian tanker in Indian Ocean
items.teaser: President Emmanuel Macron has announced that French naval forces intercepted the Russian oil tanker DF Peak south of the island of Réunion due to false flag operations.

items.title: Kinzhal is 90% identical to Iskander-M: Ukraine’s intelligence identifies 58 companies in production chain
items.teaser: Russia is developing a modified version of the Kinzhal missile, equipped with a warhead that strikes targets with fragments and a blast wave.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Ukrainska Pravda demands investigation into Austrian police conduct after journalists' detention
items.teaser: Tkach is known in Ukraine for his investigations of high-level corruption. He alleged that the arrest could have been retaliation from subjects of his investigations, who could have manipulated Austrian authorities by filing a fake report.

items.title: Ukraine budget revenue shortfall reaches UAH 50 bln — Marchenko
items.teaser: Ukraine’s state budget fell short of UAH 50 billion in planned revenue over the first nine months of 2026, with UAH 32 billion of that gap recorded in August–September.

items.title: Russian attacks on Rivne and oblast: student accommodation and residential buildings damaged
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked Rivne and Rivne Oblast, damaging non-residential facilities, student accommodation and houses.

items.title: Russian forces strike Kharkiv with Banderol missiles, injuries reported
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked Kharkiv, targeting the city's Kholodnohirskyi district.

items.title: Ballistic missiles hit Kyiv without air-raid warning: Ukraine's Air Force says no launch information was received
items.teaser: Radar systems detected the missiles only as the attack was underway, the Air Force says. Russia also attacked Kharkiv with nine S8000 Banderol missile drones.

items.title: Russian forces attack Rivne, damage reported
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the city of Rivne on the evening of October 12, causing damage.

items.title: Death toll rises to two after strike on 25-storey building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
items.teaser: Another body has been found at the site where a Russian drone crashed in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.

items.title: Zelensky: US has power and means to compel Russia to agree to real energy truce
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the United States has the power and means to force Russia to agree to a genuine energy ceasefire.

items.title: Ukraine und USA in der Krise: Was folgt auf den Diesel-Deal mit Russland?
items.teaser: Donald Trump will den Kauf russischen Diesels erlauben, was im In- und Ausland kritisiert wird. Was ist der Grund für die Entscheidung des US-Präsidenten und was soll die Ukraine tun? Die DW hat mit Experten gesprochen.

items.title: Ukraine-Krieg: Trumps Diesel-Deal mit Russland und die Folgen
items.teaser: Donald Trump will den Kauf russischen Diesels erlauben, was im In- und Ausland kritisiert wird. Was ist der Grund für die Entscheidung des US-Präsidenten und was soll die Ukraine tun? Die DW hat mit Experten gesprochen.

items.title: Brand in Starlink-Station in Polen - Festnahmen in Deutschland
items.teaser: Ende September brennt eine Starlink-Station in Polen, die auch für die Ukraine wichtig ist. Jetzt wurden in Deutschland zwei Verdächtige festgenommen. Die polnische Regierung vermutet Russland hinter dem Vorfall.

items.title: Russian forces strike rescuers again in Sloviansk while they fight fire
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a second attack on rescuers in Sloviansk, Donetsk region, while they were extinguishing a fire caused by an earlier Russian strike.

items.title: Kyiv under missile attack before air raid alert issued
items.teaser: Kyiv Independent staff reported powerful blasts in central Kyiv, with air raid sirens and mobile notifications sounding only afterward.

items.title: Zelensky holds supreme Commander-in-Chief's Staff meeting: Ukraine's front-line positions strongest in long time
items.teaser: Following a meeting of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief's Staff, President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia is suffering heavy losses every day, while Ukraine's positions on the front line are the strongest they have been in a long time.

items.title: The right to investigate suspicions does not imply the right to use any means necessary: Ukrainska Pravda's position
Air Assault Forces deny reports of Russian advance near sadky in Sumy region
items.teaser: Reports by the DeepState resource claiming that Russian forces had advanced near the village of Sadky in Sumy district are false.

items.title: Russians attack transport infrastructure facility in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a transport infrastructure facility in the Korosten district of Ukraine’s Zhytomyr region on the afternoon of October 12.

items.title: Russische Drohne schlägt in 25-stöckiges Wohnhaus in Kyjiw ein: es gibt eine Tote und elf Verletzte
items.teaser: Durch einen russischen Drohnenangriff auf ein Wohnhochhaus im Darnytskyj Bezirk von Kyjiw ist eine Person getötet und elf weitere verletzt worden, teilt der Bürgermeister von Kyjiw, Vitali Klitschko, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia not complying with energy ceasefire as of now
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky received a briefing from the Ukrainian negotiating team that had returned from the United States.

items.title: Ukraine moves to speed up privatization of state-owned assets

items.title: Selenskyj: Russland hält sich nicht an Waffenruhe
items.teaser: „Die Ukraine ist bereit, die vom US- Präsidenten angekündigte Energie- Waffenruhe zu garantieren, und Russland muss entsprechende Schritte unternehmen“, schreibt Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook nach einer Beratung mit dem ukrainischem Verhandlungsteam.

items.title: Russian drone strikes high-rise apartment building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck a 25-story residential building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian strike on Kharkiv apartment building rises to 23
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian drone strike on a high-rise apartment building in Kharkiv has risen to 23, including two children.

items.title: Fabrik für Schmierstoffe nahe Kyjiw durch russische Drohnenangriffe zerstört
items.teaser: Infolge russischer Drohnenangriffe sind Produktionsstätten des Unternehmens „KSM PROTEK“, das auf die Herstellung von Schmierstoffen spezialisiert war, komplett zerstört.

items.title: Angry at Trump's Russian diesel deal? Here's how you can help Ukraine bomb Russia
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump had a busy weekend, undermining sanctions on Russia, blaming Ukraine for the war Russia started — again — and insisting that Russian refineries become drone-free zones. items.title: Russia strikes Roshen confectionery factory in Vinnytsia
items.teaser: "The corporation's enterprises produce confectionery products and do not manufacture drones or other products for military purposes. The production complex in Vinnytsia is a civilian facility," the company said.

items.title: Vienna prosecutors say eyewitness accounts led to journalist Mykhailo Tkach's arrest. UP demands answers
items.teaser: Austrian prosecutors say eyewitness accounts led them to suspect three Ukrainians of conspiring to act as a group, but they later released journalists Mykhailo Tkach and Yaroslav Bondarenko. Ukrainska Pravda has questioned how the third-party information was verified.

items.title: Kein Zutritt für Tillschneider: Kontroverse nach Vorfall in Halle
items.teaser: Beim Gedenken an die Opfer des Anschlags von Halle war Landtags-Vize Hans-Thomas Tillschneider (AfD) der Zutritt zur Synagoge verwehrt worden. Das Thema hat hohe Wellen geschlagen. Politredakteur Engin Haupt ordnet ein.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region more than 40 times in one day, killing one and injuring six
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the city of Dnipro and the surrounding region more than 40 times throughout the day, killing one person and injuring six others.

items.title: “Zelenskyy is helping Democrats”: Trump’s MAGA base accuses Ukraine of trying to swing US midterms, says journalist in US
items.teaser: The narrative runs across all levels of the US information space, from anonymous accounts to national television.

items.title: Mehrere Verletzte nach russischen Angriffen in Dnipro und Pawlohrad
items.teaser: In Dnipro und Pawlohrad ist die Zahl der Verletzten durch russische Angriffe gestiegen, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleksandr Hanzha, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Ukraine's negotiating team briefs Zelenskyy on talks with Trump envoys
items.teaser: Ukraine’s negotiating team has briefed Zelenskyy on its meeting with Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff in the US. Zelenskyy and his negotiators have also discussed further diplomatic steps and a framework for de-escalation.

items.title: EU-Außenminister: Sanktionspaket mit willkommener Nebenwirkung
items.teaser: Noch nie hat die EU auf einen Schlag so viele Personen und Organisationen wegen des Kriegs gegen die Ukraine auf eine Sanktionsliste gesetzt wie heute. Dass das wie eine Antwort auf Trump wirkt, war nicht geplant, ist aber willkommen. Von K. Schmid.

items.title: Russian forces attack Roshen confectionery factory's production complex in Vinnytsia
items.teaser: On October 12, Russian forces attacked the production complex of the Roshen confectionery factory in Vinnytsia.

items.title: Russia’s sabotage of Europe should bring Ukraine more weapons through US purchase scheme, with clear statement of where its red lines lie, NATO’s top European commander says
items.teaser: The PURL program lets allies fund US-made weapons for Ukraine and drew nearly $5.5 billion in pledges before May.

items.teaser: The release from custody of Iryna Mudra, a former head of the President’s Office, last week followed an unusual development. items.title: Russian drone hits apartment block in Kyiv: injuries reported
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an apartment block in Kyiv with a drone on the evening of 12 October, injuring several people.

items.title: Russian attack on Hlukhiv leaves two people injured
items.teaser: Two people were injured in a Russian attack on the city of Hlukhiv in Sumy region.

items.title: Poland investigates alleged plot to kill prime minister, his deputy
items.teaser: "We are taking this matter very seriously," National Defense Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz said at a press briefing on Oct. 11.

items.title: Built by Ukraine’s ex-defense minister and unit that wrecked $12 billion of Russian gear, new interceptor downs two jet drones over Kyiv
items.teaser: Mykhailo Fedorov and Lasar’s Group commander Pavlo Yelizarov developed the drone in a month, Fedorov says.

items.title: Selenskyj: letzte Nacht griffen wir keine Energieanlagen an, Russland hingegen nahm Tankstellen und Energieanlagen in der Ukraine ins Visier
items.teaser: Die Ukraine hat in der vergangenen Nacht keine Energieanlagen in Russland angegriffen, während Russland Tankstellen, Energieinfrastruktur und andere Objekte attackiert hat, sagte Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj in einem Interview mit Fox News.

items.title: Burnham: Iran wohl verantwortlich für Militärbasis-Vorfall
items.teaser: Mehrere Männer werden verdächtigt, einen Anschlag auf einen Militärstützpunkt in Großbritannien geplant zu haben.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine attacks no energy facilities last night, while Russia struck petrol stations and energy infrastructure
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine did not attack any energy facilities in Russia last night, while Russian forces targeted petrol stations, energy infrastructure, and other facilities in Ukraine.

items.title: All EU member states agree to open negotiating clusters 2 and 3 for Ukraine
items.teaser: Ireland’s European Affairs Minister Thomas Byrne says EU countries have agreed to advance accession talks with Ukraine and Moldova, while also closing negotiating chapters for Montenegro and Albania on 13 October.

items.title: Hungarian PM reacts to Ukraine's adoption of amendments to law on education for national minorities
items.teaser: Péter Magyar thanked those involved in the negotiations after Ukraine approved amendments that ease native-language education for Hungarian children in Zakarpattia Oblast.

items.title: Finland prepared to build large-scale fortifications on border with Russia
items.teaser: Former Finnish military intelligence chief Pekka Toveri says Finland relies on its terrain and climate for defence and can quickly assemble fortifications from prefabricated elements if the security situation deteriorates.

items.title: New interceptor drone destroys two Russian Geran-5 drones in first week, Fedorov says
items.teaser: The successful test comes as Ukrainian cities are under repeated assault from Russia's new generation of jet-powered drones.

items.title: Russia is building satellite network that could put all of Europe in reach, defense executive warns
items.teaser: Oleksandr Danyliuk, head of the European defense-tech firm Destinus, called Russia’s Rassvet system an extraordinary threat, first to Ukraine and then to Europe.

items.title: Russian drone attacks destroy lubricant manufacturing plant in Kyiv region
items.teaser: Russian drone attacks have destroyed the production facilities of KSM PROTEC, a Ukrainian company specializing in the manufacture of lubricants, in Kyiv region.

items.title: Russians print images of artworks stolen from art museum on electricity bills in occupied Kherson Oblast
items.teaser: In the occupied parts of Kherson Oblast, Russians have begun printing images of artworks stolen from the Oleksii Shovkunenko Kherson Regional Art Museum on electricity bills, accompanied by propagandistic historical notes.
